content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-465. - I.P.M.C. Section 103.5, Fees.
content.summary:
Section 103.5. Fees,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
103.5. Fees.
The fees for activities and services performed by the department in carrying out
                  its responsibilities under this code shall be published."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
